A [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] '''musician''' was popular during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "A Nautolan's Best Friend" was released with the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion, it must therefore take place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref> she sought help in acquiring a pair of [[barbed ginx]]es,<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]-dwelling [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Barbed Ginx}}</ref> which were banned as pets on [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]],<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which was the Nautolan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
An individual associated with one of the two opposing governments had a companion of theirs devise a plan to acquire the ginxes.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Nautolan [[Music/Legends|musician]] was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "A Nautolan's Best Friend," released as part of the [[2014]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
